data.name: DragDropPrompt

data.name: DictationSubtitle
data.value: Run a coding assistant with your voice or a typed command

data.name: NotchSubtitle
data.value: Visibility, open panels and notch behavior

data.name: DisplaysSubtitle
data.value: Each display's notch and dock are configured separately

data.name: HideWindowsTaskbarDesc
data.value: Single dock bar on screen when Dock is active

data.name: WindowCloseNotice
data.value: Closing this window hides settings. Koy keeps running. To exit completely, use Exit Koy.

data.name: IdleRingClockDayDesc
data.value: Battery ring on the left, day and time on the right. Date and connections appear when you hover.

data.name: DockProximityTitle
data.value: When a window nears the dock

data.name: ProxReserveDesc
data.value: The dock is always visible; windows end above it, like the Windows taskbar.

data.name: ProxDockDownDesc
data.value: The dock floats; when a window gets close it snaps to the screen bottom and thins out. It stays visible over maximized windows and reserves no space.

data.name: ProxDodgeDesc
data.value: The dock hides only when a window gets close to it or is maximized; it returns when the mouse reaches the bottom edge, or when the window moves away.

data.name: ProxAlwaysHiddenDesc
data.value: The dock stays hidden whatever the windows do, until the mouse reaches the bottom edge.

data.name: ProxAlwaysFloatingDesc
data.value: The dock always floats above the bottom edge: it never snaps down, hides or reserves space, even next to a maximized window. It hides only in full screen.

data.name: RestoreTaskbarDesc
data.value: Makes Windows taskbar visible immediately if hidden

data.name: LyricsSettingDesc
data.value: Shows synced lyrics on the Home music card. While Home is open, the title and artist of what's playing are sent to LRCLIB once per track. .lrc files in Music\Lyrics are used first.

data.name: MusicWaveformTitle
data.value: Show album art and waveform when playing

data.name: MusicCardStyleDesc
data.value: Plain keeps the fixed card. Album color tints it from the cover. Album art uses the cover as a dimmed backdrop. Grey covers always use the plain card.

data.name: ScreenDockWindowsOnlyTitle
data.value: Show only windows from this display in dock

data.name: MultiMonitorNotice
data.value: When an app goes fullscreen on one display, Koy is hidden only on that display. Other displays remain unaffected.

data.name: MaterialDesc
data.value: Frosted is 86% opaque, Glass 72%; there is no blur. The Koy window, the open notch, the dock and menus follow it. The closed notch always stays solid.

data.name: NotchFollowsMaterialDesc
data.value: When off, the open notch stays solid while the window and dock can be see-through.

data.name: ReadabilityGuardDesc
data.value: On a light wallpaper, Glass moves up to Frosted (or Solid if needed) so secondary text keeps 4.5:1 contrast. The wallpaper is measured once, and again when it changes.

data.name: VoiceHarnessDesc
data.value: CLI tool that runs your command. Ctrl+Alt+V opens a box in the notch and starts Windows voice typing (Win+H): speak in your keyboard language, such as Turkish or English, or just type. Voice typing uses Microsoft's online speech recognition.

data.name: VoicePermissionDesc
data.value: Voice commands run headless, so Claude cannot ask for approval. Read-only (default) blocks creating or changing files. Edits allows file edits only. Auto lets Claude approve safe actions itself and block risky ones.

data.name: VoiceModelDesc
data.value: Model the voice command runs on. Default uses the model Claude Code is set to. Only applies to Claude.

data.name: VoiceCustomCommandDesc
data.value: Command template with optional {prompt} placeholder (e.g. gh copilot suggest "{prompt}").

data.name: VoiceWorkingDirDesc
data.value: Execution directory for CLI commands (leave blank for user profile).

data.name: SearchEmptyHint
data.value: Type to search. ? shows what you can do.

data.name: SearchConfirmRun
data.value: Run: {0}. Press Enter again to confirm

data.name: SearchSyntaxCalc
data.value: Calculates an expression. Enter puts the result in the box.

data.name: SearchSyntaxCalcFunctions
data.value: Math functions: sqrt, sin, cos, tan, ln, log, abs.

data.name: SearchSyntaxCalcBase
data.value: Shows the result in hex, bin or oct.

data.name: SearchSyntaxSession
data.value: Lock, sleep, log out, switch user, restart or shut down.

data.name: SearchSyntaxShell
data.value: Runs a command found on PATH.

data.name: SearchSyntaxLocations
data.value: Opens a file or folder path.

data.name: SearchSyntaxFiles
data.value: Searches file names in the Windows index.

data.name: SearchRetainDesc
data.value: The last search comes back selected when the panel opens.

data.name: ShortcutsNotice
data.value: Click a box and press the new combination to change it. Esc cancels, Backspace removes the shortcut. A shortcut held by another app is shown as an error on its row.

data.name: BudgetDesc
data.value: Target 100-150 MB, up to 200 MB accepted

data.name: IdleNotice
data.value: Koy uses 0% CPU when idle. Timers only run when their respective panel is open.

data.name: ShortcutErrInvalid
data.value: This key can't be used as a shortcut.

data.name: ShortcutErrReserved
data.value: Windows reserves this shortcut, choose another combination.

data.name: ShortcutErrInUse
data.value: Another app is using this shortcut, it could not be registered.

data.name: ShortcutErrFailed
data.value: The shortcut could not be registered.

data.name: ShortcutWarnTyping
data.value: This key is captured in every app, so you can't type it while this shortcut is set.

data.name: ThemeDesc
data.value: System follows the Windows app theme and updates as soon as it changes. The Koy window follows it; the notch and dock keep their own dark look.

data.name: AccentColorDesc2
data.value: Used on switches, selected items and primary buttons. Also used for the dock and notch accents (active indicator, Koy button, switches, sliders).

data.name: UseWindowsAccentDesc
data.value: Uses the Windows accent color; the color choice above is disabled.

data.name: CornerRadiusDesc
data.value: Corners of the Koy window, setup wizard and menu. The notch and dock are not affected.

data.name: AnimationDesc
data.value: Page transitions, hover and switch motion. When off, everything is instant.

data.name: ReduceMotionDesc
data.value: If animations are off in Windows, Koy turns motion off too.

data.name: MotionTogglesDesc
data.value: Turn off a single animation; it then jumps straight to its final state.

data.name: MotionTogglesDisabledHint
data.value: These have no effect while the overall animation setting is off.

data.name: ClockShowSecondsDesc
data.value: In the notch clock. Updates every second only while the notch is visible.

data.name: ClockFirstDayDesc
data.value: Used by the calendar month grid and week numbers.

data.name: ClockShowWeekNumberDesc
data.value: Next to the selected day in the calendar.

data.name: ClockCustomDateDesc
data.value: Date next to the clock in ring mode, e.g. dd.MM.yyyy. Leave empty for the default.

data.name: ClockCustomDateInvalid
data.value: This format is not valid and was not saved.

data.name: UnitNetworkSpeedDesc
data.value: Bytes (MB/s) or bits (Mb/s) on the System page.

data.name: DockNewTrayIconDesc

data.name: AdvancedSubtitle

data.value: Update checks only work in an installed build.

data.name: ResetSettingsDesc

data.value: A smart notch and a minimal floating dock for Windows 11. Let's set your preferences before you start.

data.name: WizLangDesc
data.value: Choose the language used in the app.

data.name: WizLayoutTitle
data.value: What should Koy show on screen?

data.name: WizLayoutSub
data.value: You can change this later from the Koy window.

data.name: WizNotchDesc
data.value: The Windows taskbar stays as it is.

data.name: WizDockDesc
data.value: The notch is off; clock and battery sit at the right end of the dock.

data.name: WizLocationBody
data.value: The notch can show the weather. Your location is read once when Koy starts (at most once a day) and stays on this computer; only rounded coordinates are sent to Open-Meteo for the forecast and to OpenStreetMap for the city name. You can change this later in Settings.

data.name: WizLocationNoDesc
data.value: Weather stays hidden until you pick a city or turn location on in Settings.

data.name: WeatherUseLocationDesc
data.value: Read once when Koy starts, at most once a day. Windows may ask for permission.

data.name: WeatherCityDesc
data.value: Used when location is off or unavailable. Search and pick one.

data.name: WeatherStatusNone
data.value: No location chosen: weather is hidden in the notch.

data.name: WeatherStatusDenied
data.value: Location access is blocked in Windows. Pick a city instead, or allow it in Windows Settings.

data.name: WeatherStatusFailed
data.value: Your location could not be found. Pick a city instead.

data.name: WizDoneBody
data.value: Your choices have been applied. You can change settings anytime from the menu at the bottom right or the Koy window.

data.name: WizStartupDesc
data.value: Run automatically in the background when your computer starts.

data.name: VisibilityDesc
data.value: Fixed: always visible. Smart: hides when a window covers it and returns when the mouse comes. Peek: stays hidden until the mouse reaches the screen edge or a media event happens.

data.name: UninstallRowDesc
data.value: Removes Koy from this computer. Your taskbar comes back.

data.name: UninstallOnlyInstalled
data.value: Only available in the installed version.

data.name: UninstallItemApp
data.value: The app files, shortcuts and the start-with-Windows entry are removed.

data.name: UninstallItemTaskbar
data.value: The Windows taskbar returns right away.

data.name: UninstallKeepSettingsDesc
data.value: If you reinstall Koy later, your preferences and shelf are still there.

data.name: UninstallDeleteWarn
data.value: Your settings and shelf items are deleted too. This cannot be undone.

data.name: UninstallFailed
data.value: The uninstaller could not be started. Koy is still installed; you can remove it from Windows Settings > Installed apps.

data.name: RadioOpenSettingsHint
data.value: Can't be changed from Koy. Click to open Windows settings.

data.name: RadioPrivacyHint
data.value: Koy isn't allowed to control radios. Click to open privacy settings.

data.name: DockSmallTrayDesc
data.value: The tray button becomes a narrow arrow to the right of the Koy menu button. The same tray panel opens from it.

data.name: ProxFullAlwaysShowDesc
data.value: The bar is always visible; windows end right above it, like the Windows taskbar.

data.name: ProxFullAutoHideDesc
data.value: The bar appears when the pointer reaches the bottom edge. No screen space is reserved.

data.name: DockEdgeRevealDesc
data.value: When a maximized window hides the dock, moving the pointer to the bottom edge brings it back. Never in games or full-screen video.

data.name: DockShowRecentsDesc
data.value: A stack button in the dock lists the last 10 files you opened (Windows Recent folder).
